body_markdown:
TransUnion’s TruAudience® Marketing Solutions campaign,


*Bring Clarity to Chaos: How TransUnion Turned Mindshare Into Market Share* , has won a


[2026 MediaPost OMMA Award](https://www.mediapost.com/ommaawards/winners/?utm_campaign=Press+Release+MediaPost+OMMA+Award+Clarity+to+Chaos&utm_keyword=&utm_medium=press-release&utm_source=press-release&utm_content=) in the “Technology: Hardware or Web Services” category. The win follows the campaign’s recent recognition as a 2026 AdExchanger Awards finalist in the “Most Innovative Marketing Campaign” category. The campaign was also named a finalist in this year’s Digiday Awards in the “Best Branding Campaign B2B” category.


TransUnion’s winning campaign brought its promise of clarity in a fragmented marketing landscape to life through a connected brand experience. That narrative carried across Connected TV, online video, social, podcasts, trade media and digital out-of-home. It also extended to major industry events, including Cannes Lions, CES and Advertising Week. Designed with B2B buying committees in mind, the campaign reached decision-makers in the settings where marketing professionals form their impressions of potential partners.


“Our solutions exists to help marketers bring order to a fragmented landscape, and we wanted our own marketing to demonstrate that same discipline,” said Brian Silver, EVP of Global Marketing Solutions at TransUnion. “This recognition from the OMMA Awards reflects a team that treated every channel and every industry moment as part of one coordinated story for the buying committee.”


TransUnion marketing solutions unite identity, data, audience and measurement capabilities in a single offering, giving advertisers and media companies a way to understand their customers, identify the audiences most worth reaching and see how their marketing investments perform across channels. Leveraging identity data that covers more than 98% of U.S. consumers, TransUnion helps brands connect otherwise scattered signals into a fuller picture of each customer, uncover insights they can act on, create more relevant experiences and validate their spending against business outcomes, all within privacy-centric data standards.


Learn more about TruAudience and how TransUnion helps marketers turn audience intelligence into measurable business outcomes


[here](https://www.transunion.com/solution/truaudience/clarity?utm_campaign=Press+Release+MediaPost+OMMA+Award+Clarity+to+Chaos&utm_keyword=&utm_medium=press-release&utm_source=press-release&utm_content=) .
